introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.motionBody: Every animation here points at something. When two list items merge their backgrounds, the component tells you they belong together. The hover highlight follows your cursor before you click, so the row you're about to land on confirms itself first. Motion has a job to create meaning.
introduction.hoverBody: The interaction starts before you click. The closest interactive thing to your cursor gets a faint highlight; buttons gain a little weight as you approach. By the time your finger lands, you've had a moment to reconsider, which is mostly the point.
introduction.springBody: Animations use springs, not fixed-duration eases. Toggle a switch and immediately toggle it back: the spring picks up wherever it was and reverses, instead of finishing the first animation before starting the second. Three presets, named fast, moderate, and slow, cover most of the library.
introduction.compatibilityBody: Built on shadcn/ui and Base UI. Your theme tokens (colors, radii, fonts) work as-is. One CLI command installs a component along with whatever it needs.
introduction.customizeBody: The panel on the right lets you change things on the fly. Switch between light and dark mode, adjust the brand color, and choose an icon style. Press D to switch between light and dark mode, or I to cycle icon styles from the keyboard.

skills.title: Use Zeron with your coding agent
skills.description: Copy this prompt into your project's coding agent to install both Zeron skills. Your project does not need Zeron UI installed yet.
skills.builder: Build product pages with Zeron components, layouts and real business data.
skills.migration: Migrate an existing UI while preserving routes, permissions and business behavior.
skills.prompt: Read {url} and install both zeron-page-builder and swap-to-zeronui in this project's supported skill directory. Download all supporting files, verify the installation and tell me how to invoke the skills. Preserve local changes if a skill already exists. Install skills only; do not start modifying the application.
skills.hint: Use an agent with network and file access. Codex project installs use .agents/skills/; other agents may use a different location.
skills.copyError: Could not copy automatically. Select and copy the prompt above.
skills.copySuccess: Copied. Paste the prompt into your project's coding agent.
skills.next: After installation, ask for $zeron-page-builder to build a page or $swap-to-zeronui to migrate your UI. Zeron components target React 19 and Tailwind 4; the agent checks compatibility before setup.

introduction.iconsBody: Components render named icon slots with HugeIcons defaults. The shared icon provider remains available for product-specific overrides, while the documentation site ships only the HugeIcons implementation.
